notes.title: Final demo release
notes.content: [p]✨ We’re excited to bring you the [b]final version of the Echoes in the Storm demo[/b]! ✨[/p][p]Over the past month, players have shared valuable feedback — from suggestions to critiques — and we’ve worked hard to make sure the experience feels better than ever:[/p][list][*][p]🚗 The driving sequence has been streamlined for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🕒 Subtitles now last longer, giving you more time to read every message.[/p][/*][*][p]🎙️ Improved audio and a polished radio conversation.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Object detectors fixed for easier interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]🔑 And yes… the sheriff’s drawer is finally accessible![/p][/*][/list][p]Curious to know what’s been hiding in there? Jump back into Echoes in the Storm and uncover the sheriff’s secret yourself.[/p][p]But that’s not all — we’ve also added a [b]special teaser from Chapter 3[/b]: step into the chilling morgue of the Polar Scientific Station… if you dare. 🕯️❄️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619256/489aa6b15e7ba32e35734f84155853135f1259f4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619256/142254295ad911f00e0df16c3ae546ce81368a65.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.content: [p][b]The demo for [i]Echoes in the Storm[/i] is now available![/b] Play through two full levels that introduce the story and core mechanics of the game.[/p][p]Investigate the gruesome crimes that have just shaken this remote town, now buried under a relentless snowstorm.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880200/Echoes_in_the_Storm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Explore eerie environments and uncover scattered documents to piece together the truth behind these tragic events... Though sometimes, it's better not to know the truth.[/p]
